issues: Awkward placement of {first_name} in the headline.

The sustainability buyer prefers specific supply chain transparency and certifications; simply repeating 'natural soy' and 'no synthetic fragrances' feels like a vague eco-claim to this skeptical persona.
The sentence 'Mostly bought as gifts.' is integrated very awkwardly into the body copy, reading like a copy-pasted bullet point rather than natural ad copy.
